title: Text statistics
description: words(text) returns the lowercase words of a text - letters and apostrophes only, and quotes around a word are not part of it ('hello' is hello). word_counts counts them and most_common(text, n) gives the n most used words as (word, count) pairs, equal counts in alphabetical order. diversity(text) is the share of different words, rounded to 2 places (0 for no words).
hint: Try capital letters, a tie in counts and a text with no words.
